Ollama provider sends the chat to /api/chat and maps the native reply, including token counts and finish reason

```elixir title="Elixir"
api_key = System.fetch_env!("API_KEY")
{:ok, client} = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = LiterLlm.defaultclient_chat_async(client, "{\"extra_body\":{\"num_ctx\":512,\"repeat_penalty\":1.1,\"top_k\":5},\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"ollama/qwen2:0.5b\"}")
IO.inspect(result.choices)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.choices, 0).message.content)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.choices, 0).finish_reason)
IO.inspect(result.model)
IO.inspect(result.usage.prompt_tokens)
IO.inspect(result.usage.completion_tokens)
IO.inspect(result.usage.total_tokens)
```
